description: This file contains validation functions for required and forbidden values, pointers, slices, and maps in the Kubernetes API, including optional variants.

methods.name: RequiredValue
methods.description: Verifies that the provided value is not the zero-value for its type.

methods.name: RequiredPointer
methods.description: Verifies that the provided pointer is not nil.

methods.name: RequiredSlice
methods.description: Verifies that the provided slice is not empty.

methods.name: RequiredMap
methods.description: Verifies that the provided map is not empty.

methods.name: ForbiddenValue
methods.description: Verifies that the provided value is the zero-value for its type.

methods.name: ForbiddenPointer
methods.description: Verifies that the provided pointer is nil.

methods.name: ForbiddenSlice
methods.description: Verifies that the provided slice is empty.

methods.name: ForbiddenMap
methods.description: Verifies that the provided map is empty.

methods.name: OptionalValue
methods.description: Verifies that the provided value is not the zero-value for its type, treating an error as the value not being specified.

methods.name: OptionalPointer
methods.description: Verifies that the provided pointer is not nil, treating an error as the value not being specified.

methods.name: OptionalSlice
methods.description: Verifies that the provided slice is not empty, treating an error as the value not being specified.

methods.name: OptionalMap
methods.description: Verifies that the provided map is not empty, treating an error as the value not being specified.
